meta.title: JushoAI — Fill Japanese forms into the right fields
meta.description: A Chromium browser extension that fills Japanese web forms (split names, furigana, split addresses) in one click. Rules first, AI as a helper, and a preview before anything is entered.

footer.tagline: Japanese forms, filled the right way.

hero.titleBefore: Names, furigana and addresses on Japanese forms,
hero.titleEmphasis: in the right fields and the right format
hero.tagline: Forms split into family name, given name, furigana and prefecture-to-street fields get filled in one click. You review everything in a preview first.

features.title: Built for what makes Japanese forms hard

items.title: Handles split fields as they are
items.body: Fills split family/given names, furigana, postal code, phone number and prefecture-to-building address fields in the shape each field expects.

items.title: Rules first, AI as a helper
items.body: Fields are classified by rules first; only the ambiguous ones are classified by the AI you configure. The values themselves are produced by fixed logic.

items.title: Review in a preview before filling
items.body: See the list of fields and values before anything is entered. Fields that already have a value are never overwritten.

items.title: Designed to keep your profile values local
items.body: Your profile values are never sent anywhere. When you configure an AI provider, only field metadata (name, label and the like) is sent.

mock.title: The button, the preview and the AI status
mock.uiNote: The extension's interface is in Japanese.
mock.captionButton: A "JushoAI で入力" (fill with JushoAI) button appears next to the form. The badge shows the AI status.
mock.captionPreview: Review fields and values before filling. Fields classified by the AI carry an "AI判定" (AI) mark.
mock.captionGuide: Click the badge to open a guide that explains the status and what to do.
mock.captionForm: Split fields receive values in the shape each field expects.

items.title: Register
items.body: In the settings page, register your name, furigana, email, phone number and addresses. You can register several addresses.

items.title: Press the button
items.body: Press "JushoAI で入力" that appears near the form.

items.title: Review the preview
items.body: Check the list of fields and values. If you registered several addresses, pick one here.

items.title: Fill
items.body: Press the fill button and only the fields you reviewed are filled.

items.title: Names
items.body: Works with separate family and given name fields or a single field. For a single field it reads the field's example text to decide whether to put a space between them.

items.title: Furigana
items.body: Supports full-width katakana, hiragana and half-width katakana, converting to match the field's example text or description.

items.title: Addresses
items.body: Supports addresses split into two to four fields (prefecture, city, street, building). Prefecture dropdowns are matched even when the notation differs, such as 東京 versus 東京都.

items.title: Phone and postal code
items.body: Handles hyphenated and plain numbers, in a single field or split fields, judged from the field's example text and maximum length.

items.title: Safe filling
items.body: Fields that already have a value are not overwritten, and values longer than the maximum length are not entered but flagged.

providers.title: AI, only when you want it
providers.lead: The default is "off". Choose a provider in the settings page only if you want AI to help with fields the rules cannot decide.

items.name: OpenAI-compatible API
items.body: Presets for OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Ollama and LM Studio. Enter the base URL, model name and API key.

items.name: Google Gemini
items.body: Enter the model name and API key.

items.name: Built-in browser AI
items.body: Chrome (Gemini Nano) or Edge (Phi-mini). Needs a flag and a restart, and nothing leaves your device.

items.title: Only field metadata is sent
items.body: If you configure an AI provider, the name, label, placeholder, nearby heading, type and maxlength of fields are sent to it. Your profile values and values already in fields are not. Labels and headings are text shown on the page, so personal information visible on the page can be part of what is sent.

items.title: Network only on click
items.body: Merely opening a page never contacts an AI provider.

items.title: API keys are stored encrypted
items.body: Leaked storage alone cannot decrypt them. The extension's own code can still read them.

install.title: Install
steps: It is not on the stores, so build it from source.
Open chrome://extensions (Chrome) or edge://extensions (Edge) and turn on Developer mode.
Choose "Load unpacked" and select the built dist/chrome-mv3 folder.
In the extension's settings page, register your profile and addresses.
install.more: See the "Getting started" guide for details.

items.q: Does it work on every form?
items.a: It handles common inputs (text, email, tel, and prefecture dropdowns). Fields it cannot classify are left alone.
Allow the extension's origin (chrome-extension:// followed by the extension ID) in Ollama's OLLAMA_ORIGINS setting.
